market_summary: London morning session displays extended trends in precious metals and mixed consolidation across FX, indices, and crypto. Gold is heavily overstretched below its lower ATR band at session lows. EURUSD and GBPUSD are testing upper Value Area boundaries against bearish/divergent CVD pressures. US100 and BTCUSD remain stuck in low-volume, mean-reverting mid-ranges ahead of the NY session. All setups currently lack multi-factor alignment, warranting patience across the board.

signals.rationale: Evaluating confluence: 1) Volume Profile: Price is below_val (3969.92) and below POC (3978.28), showing strong bearish trend expansion into low-volume territory. 2) CVD: cvd_label is BEARISH (-4.58) with negative slope (-1.91), confirming aggressive seller flow. 3) Session: LONDON_SESSION, highly active. 4) Trend: Price is heavily depressed below declining VWAP (3974.46) and EMA50 (3975.31). 5) ATR: Deeply extended past lower ATR band (3941.00), currently at 3925.84, showing severe short-term exhaustion. 6) RVOL: Last bar RVOL 1.087, no fresh yellow spike on the recent extension. 7) S/R: Testing Session Low at 3924.30. GEX is null. While heavily bearish, selling directly into Session Low at -2 ATR stretch presents poor scalp probability; HOLD for a pullback toward EMA20/VAL or clear consolidation.

signals.rationale: Evaluating confluence: 1) Volume Profile: Price is inside Value Area (VAL 1.10766 to VAH 1.10981) and below POC (1.10946), indicating mean-reversion conditions toward POC. 2) CVD: cvd_label is NEUTRAL (+651) with negative short-term slope (-646), showing a lack of aggressive buyer conviction. 3) Session: LONDON_SESSION. 4) Trend: Price closed above session VWAP (1.10842) and EMA50 (1.10873), showing short-term structural recovery. 5) ATR: Upper ATR band at 1.10953 capping the signal bar high (1.10956). 6) RVOL: 1.619, decent participation but lacking yellow breakout volume (>2.0). 7) S/R: Rebounded from Prev Low (1.10824), but faces immediate overhead resistance at POC (1.10946) and Session High (1.10988). GEX is null. Conflicting flow and capped by upper ATR/POC favors HOLD.

GEX is null. Due to pronounced CVD divergence and upper band resistance without volume climax confirmation, HOLD.
